title: ADR front matter for dsh-repo-standard
description: MADR 4.0.0 metadata plus the pinning fields this standard adds. The extension is in the front matter only; the MADR section structure is never modified. Source template: adr/madr template/adr-template.md (fetched 2026-09-26).

id.description: Four-digit zero-padded number allocated by CAS on refs/rs/adr-counter. Never hand-assigned after P0 seeding.

status.description: 'provisional' is this standard's extension: the decision is made but rests on something not yet verified on this machine. See the 'provisional_basis' field, which is mandatory when status is provisional.

deciders.description: MADR 'decision-makers'. Owner decisions are recorded as 'owner'.

requirements.description: Pin edge ADR -> REQ. Every element must resolve to a requirement declared in some requirements/<slug>/spec.md, else gate G2 fails.

diagrams.description: Diagram slugs under docs/architecture/diagrams/ that depict this decision.

verification.description: MADR 'Confirmation', mandatory here. Must name a check that can actually be run or observed. 'It works' is not verification.

provisional_basis.description: Required when status == 'provisional'. States exactly what is unverified and what would verify it.

artifact.description: File path, command, byte offset, URL, or quoted output that substantiates the claim.

x-optional-sections: Pros and Cons of the Options
